articles.title: More than 2,000 Canadians have donated toward restoration of 24 Sussex Drive
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney announced a national fundraising campaign to restore 24 Sussex Drive, with over 2,000 donors contributing and a design competition to select the winning restoration proposal.

articles.title: Turkey's president gifted Carney a revolver at NATO summit. Carney gave him maple syrup
articles.summary: Turkish President Erdoğan gifted Prime Minister Carney and other NATO leaders custom engraved .357 magnum revolvers, which Carney said were deactivated and will be placed in a museum.

articles.title: Carney courts Saudi Arabia as U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapses
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney held high-level talks in Saudi Arabia to deepen diplomatic and economic ties, condemned Iranian attacks on Gulf shipping, and stated that engagement rather than lecturing is an effective diplomatic strategy.

articles.title: Carney backs latest U.S. strikes on Iran as Trump slams NATO allies
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney endorsed U.S. strikes on Iran as a justified response to ceasefire violations and stated that NATO countries recognize they need to increase defence spending responsibility.

articles.title: Carney appoints one of his top advisers and a Conservative MP to Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney appointed senior adviser Tom Pitfield and Conservative MP Richard Martel to the Senate, departing from former PM Trudeau's decade-long practice of appointing non-partisan senators.
